text:
Man City were found guilty by an independent commission and are appealing. Maresca on Friday: are the titles tainted? "Absolutely not." Relegation to League One? "I won the Championship with Leicester, so in case League One, we are going to see." Liverpool vs Man City is on Sunday. Your take? 👇
#ManCity #Maresca #PremierLeague #Liverpool #Football
titulo: Maresca on City's verdict: 'Absolutely not' and the League One line
